mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_code, upload_id, file_id, file_name, file_size, content_type, category, is_public, oss_sp, bucket_name, part_count, completed_parts, status, expire_time, sort, create_time, create_by, update_time, update_by, remark, version FROM mdm_fileos_multipart WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN ('INIT', 'UPLOADING') AND expire_time < #{expireTime}
mapper.update: UPDATE mdm_fileos_multipart SET status = #{status}, version = version + 1 WHERE deleted = 0 AND upload_id = #{uploadId}
